doc: Marksman team (2 marksman rifles, 70 m) attack-moves on an unarmed dummy from 80 m, with a disarmed friendly spotter 40 m short of it (the team's sight is 60 m, the spotter's 45 m, so the marksmen get the target through the spotter). The marksman behaviour (sw-txnj.11, humanity.json marksman_attack_move) keeps the band up to range - 5 = 65 m (keep_distance max_m): the team stops within 5 m of its range, not at its edge. Pinned absolute DPS over the first contact turn; the stop distance is the acceptance check.

probes.doc: Team DPS from its first shot at the dummy over turn 1, 3.03 (5%). Pinned by sw-txnj.11.
Last frame: the team stops within 5 m of its 70 m range (65-70 m); keep_distance max_m 65 suspends the 70 m edge.
